name: Mirrored Alphabet Rabbit-Hop Coordinate Algorithm
purpose: Symbolic identity, coordinate, and route compiler for alphabet-based rabbit hops.

generator.primitive_state: (n, k, s) -- identity, reference displacement, local polarity
generator.derived_coordinates: p = n + k (anchor); m = 2p; r = m + s
generator.k_meaning: look-ahead (k>0) / look-behind (k<0) / own position (k=0), reference displacement from identity
generator.s_meaning: ternary local differential, same primitive as -1(0)+1 foundational choice
generator.degeneracy_warning: (p,s) or (p,r) ALONE is insufficient -- (n=4,k=1) and (n=5,k=0) both give p=5 and, at equal s, the identical (m,r) pair, yet represent different states. n must be retained as an independent coordinate; it is not recoverable from (p,r) alone.
generator.no_privileged_k: k=0,+-1 are not special to the algebra -- tested k in [-5,+5] with no qualitative change anywhere in range; they were simply the values the original packet and the two-family proposal happened to use.
generator.note: Replaces the earlier framing of two independent arithmetic families. Brute-force verified: the proposed second family (n,2(n+1),2(n+1)+-1) is exactly this generator at k=1, re-anchored to n, not independent arithmetic.

operator_algebra.composition: T_a(T_b(state)) == T_(a+b)(state), verified over full tested range -- T is a homomorphism from (Z,+)
operator_algebra.commutation: P(T_a(state)) == T_a(P(state)), verified over full tested range -- reference-shift and polarity-flip are independent, commuting operators
operator_algebra.group_structure: the group generated by all T_a and P is Z x Z/2, acting on (k,s) with n fixed throughout
operator_algebra.domain_topology_kept_separate: alphabet linear boundary, tonal mod-12 wraparound, half-mirror sequence-reversal, and round-trip orientation-exchange are declared independently of this algebra, not folded into T_a or P

legacy_packet.note: Equals the generator at k=0, s=+1 (positive) / sign-mirrored (negative). Preserved unmodified as a special case.

branch_decode.legacy_k0_only: b=abs(r)-2*abs(n), b in {0,1} -- valid only when k=0 is already fixed by context
branch_decode.general: k=m/2-n, s=r-m, s in {-1,0,1} -- given full triple (n,m,r); resolves the collision the legacy formula has when k!=0 is possible

mirror_rules.half_mirror_reverse: reverse(X+[0]+Y) = reverse(Y)+[0]+reverse(X) -- ordinary sequence reversal, for A..M(0)N..Z forms only
mirror_rules.round_trip_orientation_exchange: exchange(X+[0]+Y) = Y+[0]+X -- arm swap, NOT sequence reversal, for A..Z(0)Z..A forms only
mirror_rules.note: A round-trip sequence is a palindrome under sequence reversal (reverses to itself); applying reverse() to it is a no-op. These two operators must not be cross-applied.

domain_boundary.alphabet: linear, bounded [1,26]; look-ahead at Z (n=26,k=+1) is undefined, no letter 27
domain_boundary.tonal: cyclic, wraps mod 12; look-ahead at G# (n=12,k=+1) wraps to A

tonal_extension.cardinality_note: 12 unique states; a closure traversal (A..G#, return to A) gives 13 visits, NOT 13 unique states. Alphabet-half symbol count (13) corresponds to the 13-visit traversal count only, not state cardinality.
tonal_extension.boundary_with_E510: E-510 Music Clock owns harmonic/chord/rotational-position meaning for the 12-tone system. This tonal extension is identity/coordinate grammar only (same generator as the alphabet, applied to a 12-symbol set) -- explicitly not a harmonic claim, per E-510's own separation rule.

new_predictions: s=0 at k!=0 is a valid, previously-unused coordinate (Hold, k positions ahead/behind)
look-behind (k<0) works symmetrically with no privileged values, verified for k in [-5,+5]
alphabet Z-boundary has no tonal counterpart (linear vs cyclic domain asymmetry)
reference-shift and polarity-flip are independent, COMMUTING group operators (T_aT_b=T_(a+b), PT_a=T_aP) -- proven algebraic independence, not just table-column independence
s in {-1,0,+1} is a candidate structural match for G-744's Field/Mirror/Void ternary and B-223's Three Moves -- not confirmed
claim_gate_detail: BRONZE (coordinate packet, generator, and mirror grammar, brute-force verified) / YELLOW (embodied-motion implementation)
